title: Prioritize arrival quality before pushing tiny static speed
summary: On small static tasks like 1wXTS, score improves more reliably when the first arrive-and-click is clean than when raw tempo rises while misses keep multiplying.
why: Tiny static tasks punish misses heavily, so extra cleanup motion and overshoot destroy chaining value fast.
The player usually gains more by cleaning the first arrival than by forcing faster but sloppier target exits.
actions: Arrive under control on the first motion and click as soon as the acquire standard is met.
If the run is filling with rescue micro-adjustments, lower tempo slightly until the first landings clean up.
Track how often you need extra correction after the initial move instead of only tracking raw cadence.
avoid: Do not force more speed while the first landing is still unstable.

drills.label: Voltaic S5 1wXTS small static
drills.reason: Small static targets expose whether first-arrival quality is good enough before speed gets pushed.

evidence.claim: Small static clicking heavily punishes misses, making arrival quality and micro-adjustment discipline more important than brute-force tempo.
evidence.excerpt: Voltaic describes 1wXTS as a tiny-target static family where misses are expensive.
